title: Design System: Nurik's Academy Operations Platform

display.purpose: Rare screen-defining statements and high-level authentication context.

headline.purpose: Section headers for familiar dashboard groups and operational regions.

body.purpose: Record content, instructions, and explanatory copy.

shadows.name: quiet-edge
shadows.purpose: Minimal web separation where a hairline alone is insufficient.

shadows.name: temporary-overlay
shadows.purpose: Menus, popovers, and medium transient surfaces.

shadows.name: modal-lift
shadows.purpose: Large modal or overlay separation only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The academy-brass action that advances the current task; the login instance is 52px high.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid #E8CC72; border-radius: 6px; background: #D9B84A; color: #11110D; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D9B84A; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.82; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.58; cursor: default; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A substantial warm-black field with a persistent label and explicit focus or error treatment.
components.css: .ds-input-group { display: grid; gap: 8px; width: min(100%, 420px); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-input-label { color: #B6B3AA; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-input-wrap { display: flex; min-height: 52px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #41423B; border-radius: 6px; background: #0D0E0C; color: #87877F; } .ds-input-icon { width: 19px; height: 19px; flex: none; } .ds-input-field { min-width: 0; flex: 1; min-height: 50px; padding: 12px 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #F3F0E7; font: inherit; font-size: 16px; } .ds-input-field::placeholder { color: #87877F; } .ds-input-wrap:hover { border-color: #B6B3AA; } .ds-input-wrap:focus-within { border-color: #D9B84A; outline: 2px solid #D9B84A; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-input-wrap:has(.ds-input-field[aria-invalid="true"]) { border-color: #D86B57; }

components.name: Academy Metric
components.description: A compact Academy overview record with a tabular value and supporting label.
components.css: .ds-metric { display: flex; width: 180px; min-height: 96px; justify-content: space-between; flex-direction: column; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #292A25; border-radius: 6px; background: #11120F; color: #F3F0E7; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-metric-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; color: #D9B84A; } .ds-metric-top strong { font-size: 26px; line-height: 30px; font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-metric-mark { font-size: 12px; } .ds-metric-label { color: #B6B3AA; font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Operational Summary
components.description: A flat ruled group used for Today and Student Status summaries.
components.html:
●Lessons Today12
●Support Bookings4
components.css: .ds-summary { overflow: hidden; width: min(100%, 420px); border: 1px solid #292A25; border-radius: 6px; background: #11120F; color: #F3F0E7; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-summary-row { display: grid; min-height: 58px; grid-template-columns: 19px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #292A25; font-size: 14px; } .ds-summary-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-summary-icon { color: #D9B84A; font-size: 9px; } .ds-summary-row strong { min-width: 28px; color: #D9B84A; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 800; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Role Action Row
components.description: A familiar Staff Management or Admin Tools destination with label, explanation, and forward cue.
components.css: .ds-action-row { display: flex; width: min(100%, 440px); min-height: 78px; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #292A25; border-radius: 6px; background: #11120F; color: #F3F0E7; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-action-row:hover { border-color: #41423B; } .ds-action-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D9B84A; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-action-row:active { opacity: 0.72; } .ds-action-icon { display: grid; width: 38px; height: 38px; flex: none; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #41423B; border-radius: 4px; background: #0D0E0C; color: #D9B84A; } .ds-action-icon svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; } .ds-action-copy { display: grid; min-width: 0; flex: 1; gap: 3px; } .ds-action-copy strong { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-action-copy small { color: #B6B3AA; font-size: 12px; line-height: 17px; } .ds-action-chevron { color: #87877F; font-size: 24px; }

components.name: Persistent Bottom Navigation
components.description: The role-filtered bottom bar used at every width; short role sets center, while larger sets scroll when space is tight.
components.html: HomeStudentsFinanceChatsProfile
components.css: .ds-bottom-nav { overflow-x: auto; min-height: 64px; padding-top: 5px; border-top: 1px solid #41423B; background: #11120F; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; scrollbar-width: none; } .ds-bottom-nav::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; } .ds-nav-items { display: flex; width: max-content; min-width: 100%; min-height: 56px; justify-content: center; padding: 0 8px; } .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; width: 76px; min-width: 64px; max-width: 112px; min-height: 56px; flex: 1 1 76px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 4px; color: #87877F; font-size: 9px; line-height: 12px; font-weight: 650; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 21px; height: 21px; margin-bottom: 1px; } .ds-nav-item::before { position: absolute; top: -1px; left: 4px; right: 4px; height: 1px; background: transparent; content: ""; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #B6B3AA; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D9B84A; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-nav-item-active { color: #D9B84A; } .ds-nav-item-active::before { background: #D9B84A; } @media (max-width: 380px) { .ds-nav-items[data-large-role="true"] { justify-content: flex-start; padding: 0 4px; } .ds-nav-items[data-large-role="true"] .ds-nav-item { width: 76px; min-width: 76px; flex: 0 0 76px; } }

components.css: .ds-login-stage { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: grid; min-height: 240px; place-items: center; padding: 24px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(8,9,7,.78), rgba(8,9,7,0), rgba(8,9,7,.78)), linear-gradient(180deg, #151208 0%, #0B0B0B 55%, #080907 100%); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-speck { position: absolute; width: 2px; height: 2px; border-radius: 999px; background: #D4AF37; } .ds-speck-a { top: 14%; left: 7%; opacity: .28; } .ds-speck-b { top: 32%; left: 82%; opacity: .22; } .ds-speck-c { top: 76%; left: 78%; opacity: .16; } .ds-login-panel { z-index: 1; width: min(100%, 360px); padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #41423B; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(17,18,15,.94); color: #F3F0E7; } .ds-login-panel h3 { margin: 16px 0 4px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid #292A25; font-size: 26px; line-height: 31px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-login-panel p { margin: 0; color: #B6B3AA; font-size: 14px; } .ds-login-panel .ds-login-kicker { color: #D9B84A; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .45px; }

narrative.overview:
Nurik's Institutional Register makes academy operations feel disciplined, branded, and dependable. Warm-black working fields carry warm-white information; brass gold identifies the current destination and the next valid action; the real academy mark establishes ownership before the interface asks anyone to work. The product is serious and pleasant, never promotional, childish, or styled like a futuristic AI dashboard.

Identity and current operational status lead the reading order. Familiar role tasks follow in stable groups, with one-pixel rules, flat tonal surfaces, compact type, and tabular values doing the organizational work. Decoration stays quiet enough for repeated use at reception, in lessons, and during finance review.

The same world extends to authentication through a compact form over a lightweight cross-platform gradient and sparse static gold specks derived from the public Nurik's Academy site. The atmosphere establishes family resemblance without importing marketing-page scale, motion, or composition.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-black fields and warm-white copy create a focused operational canvas.
Brass gold marks active navigation, primary action, and decisive links with restraint.
The real academy mark and role identity lead before grouped work begins.
One-pixel rules, modest radii, and tabular values support fast scanning.
A persistent role-specific bottom bar preserves familiar destinations at every width.

rules.name: The Brass Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Gold marks the current selection, one primary action, or a decisive link; it is never a decorative wash.

rules.name: The Status Is Language Rule
rules.body: Semantic color reinforces a visible label, value, or icon; color never carries operational meaning by itself.

rules.name: The Numeric Trust Rule
rules.body: Money, dates, times, counts, and dashboard values use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Workhorse Type Rule
rules.body: System type carries controls and operational content; custom display type and oversized marketing headlines do not enter the app shell.

rules.name: The Flat Register Rule
rules.body: Resting work surfaces stay flat; shadow belongs only to a menu, modal, or temporary overlay.

rules.name: The Quiet Atmosphere Rule
rules.body: The login gradient and gold specks are static background material, never glow, blur, parallax, or continuous animation.

dos: Do lead with the academy identity and current role or operational status.
Do preserve Academy overview, Today, Student Status, Staff Management, and Admin Tools as the familiar dashboard groups.
Do use gold for the active navigation rule, one primary action, and short decisive links.
Do keep interactive targets at least 48px and inputs at least 52px high.
Do pair every status color with text and use tabular numerals for dates, times, counts, and UZS.
Do keep every role-valid destination reachable in the persistent bottom bar, using horizontal scroll only when required.
donts: Don't replace familiar operational grouping with a timeline, novel dashboard narrative, or compensation-first summary.
Don't move primary navigation away from the persistent bottom bar or change the role's established route set for visual neatness.
Don't turn operational sections into nested floating card stacks or bento layouts.
Don't use large decorative radii, gradient text, texture, heavy blur, glow, huge type, or continuous animation.
Don't fill the active navigation item with a rounded tile; use one thin gold top rule.
Don't use shadows on resting content surfaces, color as the only status cue, or a second primary action in one task context.
